name: player_compute_surface_from1_probe
description: Player::ComputeSurfaceFrom1Probe fits a support plane from the first above-ground environment probe and applies the resulting terrain tilt impulse.
known_limits: tier S verification is deferred to the Player environment-probe surface-fit pass so probe-selection globals, x87 expression ordering, and terrain tilt caller context can be compared together.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja HLIL for 0x42c520 validates use of g_PlayerEnvProbe_AboveGroundIndices[0], the selected world probe point with Y replaced by candidateScoreBySample[index], support-plane dot product against steerBasisRef, SolveHeightOnSurface, cross-product tilt construction, and ApplyTerrainTilt with scale 1.0.
The native smoke verifies the selected sample index, solved world Y, and terrain tilt clamp effects for the one-probe surface path.
